setup.why: get_selected_report_testcases' path_params (project_id, report_id) are both integer; list_schedules is the discovery call that resolves the SC-NNN a caller would have from list_reports_v2 into the integer id this route actually needs

declared_missing: selection_data: root `required` array marks it mandatory, typed `object` with its own required sub-fields (select_all, folders, unique_test_case_count), not nullable anywhere in the schema. The live 200 response returned selection_data: null — a bare JSON null, not an object, so none of select_all/folders/unique_test_case_count could be checked. This also directly contradicts the capability's own guidance, which says for exactly this state (a report with no case filters saved, and report_filters:{} was confirmed for SC-12541 via get_report_detail/list_reports_v2 in the sibling run files) it 'simply returns an unfiltered project selection tree' — i.e. a populated folder-keyed object, not null.

empty_case_check.rule_applied: selection ({}) alone would be the documented empty case (no saved selection) and would leave the folder-tree item shape UNVERIFIED rather than exercised. But selection_data is not merely empty here — it is null, a type violation of a declared-required, non-nullable object field, and it directly contradicts the guidance's explicit promise of an 'unfiltered project selection tree' for a report with no case filters. Per the shallowest-missing-path rule this is reported as DRIFT, not downgraded to UNVERIFIED. The deeper question of whether folders/select_all/unique_test_case_count individually match their sub-schema remains unexercised as a consequence, not the primary finding.
